title: time-manager
description: `time-manager` is an eight-step trigger sequencer for structuring larger compositions, with independently set step times from 1 to 120 seconds, individual step outputs, and an ALL output for every trigger. It requires a musically relevant trigger source at its SYNC input and waits for that input before emitting a due trigger, keeping its outputs synchronized with the patch; looping, start/stop, and reset controls manage playback.
